reports.title: Generate a PDF report
reports.intro: Choose the report, the scope and the campaign. The PDF downloads as soon as it is ready.

hint.cohesion: Employees' opinions: participation, index, criteria, trend, manager's view, recommendations. Available once the anonymity threshold is reached.
hint.relational: Relationship map, pivot people, tensions, asymmetries, catalysts and toxins. Named report.
hint.psi: Overall index, four dimensions, twelve statements, trend and reading by department. Available once the anonymity threshold is reached.
hint.strengths: Collective People / Business board and consolidated individual strengths and development areas.
hint.team_id: Team vision, values, achievements, objectives and results, members' skills and cohesion.
hint.id3a: Aptitudes × Attitudes matrix, quadrants, performance levels, movements since the previous campaign.
hint.ninebox: Performance × progression grid, action per box, driving leaders and talents at risk.
hint.tpd: Each talent's performance and progression, ranking, trajectories over recent campaigns.
hint.person_id: A person's Performance ID: background, motivations, evaluations, strengths, development plan.

reports.failed: The report could not be generated. Please try again shortly.
